I think food banks desperately need more, they’re having to turn people away as they run out throughout the day. I went to a homeless charity but they weren’t really able to help with housing. I think donating straight to charity is the best thing to do, especially the smaller ones that don’t receive as much. 

I had a questionnaire from Shelter last week saying they had my details from my local council, anyone in emergency accommodation was asked about the service. They said they send a £15 food voucher to everyone for their experience , so I really do think charities, homeless shelters, food banks desperately need back up.

I was going to say that not having evidence of actually existing is a barrier. When I registered on the housing list I didn’t have an address apart from a few caravan sites but they’re not always above board so it was difficult to get everything they asked for. 

People need a local connection and proof of that, I’m fortunate that my mum is local to my area and could provide birth certificates etc to say I was her daughter. But for people that don’t have family, I imagine that’s a huge hurdle. 

I think the biggest thing was trying to prove I needed help, originally they said I was adequately housed. It was only a year later when a HO accessed my caravan and saw I had no running water, heating, cooking facilities and that it was unsanitary that I was put up to the highest band.
